rows.status: Substituted by HB10688

rows.author: B001
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE EMPOWERMENT OF LOCAL GOVERNMENT UNITS FOR THE MAINTENANCE OF PEACE AND ORDER IN THEIR RESPECTIVE TERRITORIES WHILE SUSTAINING THE PROFESSIONALIZA TION OF THE PHILIPPINE NATIONAL POLICE AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES, AMENDING CERTAIN PROVISIONS OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 6975, ENTITLED "AN ACT ESTABLISHING THE PHILIPPINE NATIONAL POLICE UNDER A REORGANIZED DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT," AS AMENDED BY REPUBLIC ACT NO. 8551, ENTITLED "AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE REFORM AND REORGANIZATION OF THE PHILIPPINE NATIONAL POLICE AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: RESTRUCTURES the PNP into two (2) major branches --- (1) the national branch and the (2) local branch. This bill, therefore, provides for the  (1) decentralizatio n of some administrative and operational aspects of the NAPOLCOM and the PNP; (2) retention of the national scope of the PNP, while strengthening its civilian character and professionalizi ng the police force.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC ORDER AND SECURITY since 1998-11-10

rows.author: C086
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR A FIVE-YEAR MORATORIUM ON THE FORECLOSURE OF ALL MORTGAGES WITH BANKS AND FINANCIAL INSTITUTIONS, WHETHER PUBLIC OR PRIVATE, AND PROVIDING PENALTIES FOR ANY VIOLATION THEREFOR
rows.abstract: There shall be a fie-year moratorium ending December 31, 2003 on the foreclosure of all mortgages with banks and financial institutions, whether public or private. Rationale: The regional financial crisis which started in Thailand in July 1997 has spread worldwide ... The Philippines was not spared from these tragic events --- the currency meltdown, the drought and the resulting havoc on agriculture.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BANKS AND FINANCIAL INTERMEDIARIES since 1998-11-10

rows.abstract: This bill aims to rationalize the tax burdens imposed by different tax laws which affect Philippine businesses. It sets a MAXIMUM CEILING of 50% of gross sales as the maximum amount of tax a business has to pay the National Government every fiscal year.
